Synopsis: Aradin is yelling to Klank because it is blocking the entrance to the Sorcerous Sundries shop. Aradin asks the player whether they had success on the quest of the nightsong and leaves.LORR-oh-AH-kan. Cluster Contexts: - LOW_SorcerousSundries_Aradin.json: Aradin is parked in front of the Sorcerous Sundries, shouting at Klank (the construct blocking the shop entrance) and making a public scene. Off‑screen he was hired by Lorroakan, the wizard owner, to recover the "Nightsong" and led men into a goblin hive—he suffered casualties and now blames Lorroakan for sending him after what he thought was a relic. The player has already been involved with the Nightsong quest (one possible outcome being they found the Nightsong and discovered it is actually an aasimar), so Aradin turns to the player to ask whether they had any success and to demand Lorroakan pay up. He’s agitated and threatening, but ultimately leaves after pressing the point. - DEN_AdventurerLeader.json: Adventurer leader dialogue. Mostly used during Adventurers Quest. This is after the player has stopped Zevlor and Aradin from fighting one another. Aradin returns to his den to lick his wounds. - LOW_SorcerousSundries_Rolan.json: Dialog with Sorcerous Sundries' clerk Rolan. He will explain how Lorroakan is neglecting him in his search for the Nightsong. Player can ask Rolan to make a portal to Lorroakan. - LOW_SorcerousSundries_NightsongPostAttack.json: Nightsong's dialogue after Aradin attacks the Camp and is repelled. - LOW_SorcerousSundries_LorroakanConclusion.json: Lorroakan's dialoge after winning the fight against Nightsong. In gameplay he will attempt to fit her into the soul cage device (after this dialogue-- this should remain bronze).
